statement: ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) ℂ V), (∀ i, b i = LR.vec y v i.val) → ∀ i j : Fin (l+1), LR.divided x (l-i.val) * (LR.divided y l * LR.divided x l) * LR.divided y (l-j.val) = (Nat.choose l j.val : ℂ) • LR.unit l b i j
proof:
intro b hb i j
have hp := h_T006 b hb
have umul : ∀ i j k : Fin (l+1), LR.unit l b i k * LR.unit l b k j = LR.unit l b i j := by
  intro i j k
  ext w
  simp [LR.unit, Module.End.mul_apply]
rw [hp.1, mul_assoc, hp.2.2 j, mul_smul_comm]
congr 1
rw [← umul ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩ j ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩, ← mul_assoc, hp.2.1 i, umul]

  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    LR.N1 l x y h v →
      (∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ LR.localRing p ↔ ∃ a d, ¬↑p ∣ d ∧ q = ↑a / ↑d) ∧ LR.LocalBasis p l M →
        LR.LocalStable p M x y →
          (∀ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (l + 1)) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Fin (l + 1)), b i = LR.vec y v ↑i) → LR.PartialUnits l x y b) →
            ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (l + 1)) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Fin (l + 1)), b i = LR.vec y v ↑i) →
                ∀ (i j : Fin (l + 1)),
                  LR.divided x (l - ↑i) * (LR.divided y l * LR.divided x l) * LR.divided y (l - ↑j) =
                    ↑(l.choose ↑j) • LR.unit l b i j
